function menu(prenom) {
  return [
    '👨‍🍳 Welcome to Meal Prep Chef' + (prenom ? ', ' + prenom : '') + '!',
    '',
    'I\'m your kitchen sidekick for the week you planned on Meal Prep. I show you what\'s cooking, walk you through every recipe step by step, keep your shopping list in your pocket, and answer any cooking question along the way.',
    '',
    '📅 Your week',
    '/today — what\'s cooking now (add lunch, dinner, tomorrow or a day)',
    '/week — your whole week at a glance',
    '/list — your shopping list, by aisle',
    '',
    '📖 Recipes',
    '/recipe — the full recipe with every step',
    '/ingredients — just the ingredients',
    '/swap — replace a meal you don\'t fancy',
    '',
    '🍳 Cook with me',
    '/cook — a guided session, one step at a time',
    'next · back · repeat — move through the steps',
    '/timer 10 — I\'ll ping you when 10 minutes are up',
    '/stop — end the session',
    '',
    '💬 Or just talk to me: "can I use chickpeas instead of lentils?", "how do I know the chicken is done?", "what can I prep tonight for tomorrow?"',
    '',
    'Every command understands a slot: /cook friday dinner, /recipe tomorrow lunch.'
  ].join('\n');
}

const p = $('Parse Intent').first().json.prenom;
return [{ json: { texte: menu(p) + '\n\nNot connected yet? On the site, log in, open a plan and tap "Cook with Telegram".' } }];
